title: Contract utilization sentinel - ramp scenarios
content:
Sheet: Contract-level allocation + ramp scenarios (Sentinel overlay)

Tab 1 - Per-contract snapshot (as of 2027-07-14)
Columns: ContractID,Customer,PrimaryRegion,ModelClass,A100e-equiv-reserved,Committed-monthly-hours,Trailing-90d-util%,Peak-week-hours-last-90d,Runway-months-if-avg-util,Buffer-policy,Notes
C-2027-001,AtlasAI,us-west1,chat-heavy,48,34560,0.62,10240,6,10% burstable to dedicated-burst,New legal addendum allows 10% burst; monitor queue latency
C-2026-177,FinLogic,eu-west3,embeddings,12,8640,0.48,3200,4,static pin,Customer requests strict region pin; no cross-region fallback
C-2025-320,Healthly,us-east4,instruct,24,17280,0.75,5600,9,canary-increase,Seasonal spike in Nov-Dec expected; suggest temporary +8 GPUs in Nov
C-2027-010,CommerceX,ap-south1,conversational,36,25920,0.55,7600,5,graceful-fallback-to-small,Require 99.5% availability; route small requests to cheaper quantized model on fallback
C-2024-089,MediaForge,us-west1,rerank,8,5760,0.33,1400,2,burst-only,Low steady utilization; high short bursts during campaign launches
C-2026-409,EdgeOps,eu-central1,chat-heavy,64,46080,0.81,14800,12,buffered-slab-20pct,High-util long-running; propose retention of 20% idle buffer
C-2025-221,AdPulse,us-east4,embeddings,16,11520,0.40,3800,3,preemptible-burst,Cost-sensitive; allow preemptible during non-peak

Tab 2 - Sentinel ramp scenarios (3 variants)
Scenario,Description,Trigger,Short-term-action,Extra-GPUs-to-provision,Estimated-additional-monthly-cost
Baseline,current contracts + historical smoothing,none,monitor,0,$0
Moderate-ramp,customers increase usage by 25% over 8 weeks,week-over-week +15% sustained across 2 major contracts,provision pooled-burst slab to us-west1 + ap-south1,28,$44,800
Stress-ramp,two large contracts shift peak simultaneously (holiday + product launch),simultaneous spike to 2.2x baseline,alarm threshold: cluster 90%+ for >4h,activate emergency-burst pool across regions with cross-region fallback,96,$153,600

Tab 3 - Region capacity ledger (quick view)
Region,Total-A100e-equivalent-installed,Committed-reserved,Available-headroom,Observed-90d-average-usage,Notes
us-west1,320,156,164,0.61,primarily chat + rerank; good runway if buffered 10% retained
eu-west3,128,48,80,0.45,embed-heavy; consider small transfer window for temporary EU bursts
us-east4,256,104,152,0.58,mix of instruct + embeddings; seasonal peaks in Nov-Jan
ap-south1,96,44,52,0.53,fast growth; latency-sensitive customers increasing demand
eu-central1,160,64,96,0.66,high sustained utilization from EdgeOps

Tab 4 - Allocation heuristics (rules we applied in this sheet)
- Keep per-contract pinned slab where legal/regulatory requires (explicit in contract)
- For customers with "burst" clauses, map to a shared burst slab sized to no more than 20% of region installed GPUs
- Maintain a sentinel emergency pool sized to cover top-2 simultaneous stress ramps for the region mix (calculated as 0.3 * sum(top2 commit) as placeholder)
- If trailing 90d utilization > 0.7 and runway > 9 months, recommend conversion conversation with sales to dedicated + larger buffer
- Preemptible-only allowances must be flagged in billing and SLA docs

Tab 5 - Quick formulas and assumptions (human-readable)
- A100e-equiv-reserved: normalized to A100 80GB baseline for comparison
- Committed-monthly-hours = GPUs_reserved * 720 (assume 30d month)
- Runway-months-if-avg-util = (Available-headroom * 720) / (Committed-monthly-hours * observed-util) approximated per-contract
- Cost assumptions: $1,600/month per A100e-equivalent reserved baseline; pooled-burst pricing = 0.35 * reserved price per GPU-hour; emergency-burst on cloud marketplaces estimated at 3x baseline hourly

Summary observations (ops notes):
- AtlasAI (C-2027-001) is the loudest near term risk: 62% trailing util but large recorded week peaks; burst clause + 10% legal allowance means we should place them on sentinel watch and pre-stage 8 GPUs in us-west1 for two-week windows tied to their release calendar.
- EdgeOps continues to have highest sustained utilization; conversion to a larger committed slab + 20% buffer reduces emergency-burst exposure.
- MediaForge and AdPulse are good candidates for preemptible-burst policies to save cost; add explicit billing flag and opt-in form in Console.

Action items (owner assignments):
- Anika: finalize sentinel alarm thresholds and add cross-region fallback playbook (due 2027-07-21)
- Riley: simulate stress-ramp with 96 extra GPUs using the ramp-scenarios script and post results in linked GitHub (due 2027-07-18)
- Miguel: contact AtlasAI solutions lead to confirm release cadence and validate suggested 8-GPU pre-stage (due 2027-07-19)
- Priya: draft short customer communication template for preemptible-burst option (due 2027-07-22)

Appendix (notes / unresolved questions):
- Need clearer per-contract language around cross-region fallback for EU-regulated customers (FinLogic) — legal follow-up required
- Validate cost model with finance: pooled pricing assumption is a placeholder pending procurement rates
- Consider expanding sentinel to include token-level queuing metrics (pending telemetry effort from observability team)

End of sheet.
